name: ramson-colour-coaters
description: Ramson Colour Coaters - Full Stack React + Admin Dashboard + Express + Node.js Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin-dashboard
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix admin-dashboard
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run server:dev" "npm run client" "npm run admin"
